d:
Bihar ki rajdhani patna ke alingar sthit rahmani 30 ke garls hostal men subah-subah aag lagne ki ghatna se ilake men aphra-taphri mach gaee. aag hostal bilding ke pahle aur dusre phlor par lagi thi, jis par suchna milte hi mauke par pahunchi phayar briged ki tim ne kari mashakkat ke bad kabu pa liya. ganimat rahi ki is ghatna men garls hostal ki sabhi chhatraen puri tarah surakshit hain.
Short sarkit ki aashanka, phayar phaiting sistam kam na karne par uthe saval
